Towers and cities

The Eiffel Tower is 330 metres tall and was completed in 1889 for the World's Fair in Paris.

Critics at the time called it an eyesore, but it is now one of the most visited monuments in the world.

Paris has about 2.1 million residents, while the wider metropolitan area holds more than 12 million people.

  • The tower has 1,665 steps from the ground to the top platform, according to its operator.
